# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Use the maps.
3. Visit the location.
4. Document what you see by photographing the contaminated area.
5. Take samples, if appropriate.
6. Call a certified water-quality lab.
7. Take your samples to the certified lab.
8. Verify test results with labs.
9. Report the problem to all appropriate agencies.

Use the instructions and the resources listed on this website to file a complaint and get your water tested. If you don’t have regular Internet access, use a public library’s computers for free. If Internet access doesn’t work in your area, you can still file a complaint by calling your state’s Department of Environmental Protection. If you have difficulty doing this, call your local radio station, who may be willing to put you in touch with an environmental attorney.
